_comment: A curated, dated backstop of security advisories against the SOUP in
soup.lock.json, checked by scripts/ESP32C5/cvecheck.py. This is the
offline control that always runs (CI, unit_tests/soup). The live feed is
cvecheck.py --online (OSV), run on a schedule by
.github/workflows/soup-cve.yml -- that is how NEW advisories are found; add
confirmed ones here with their fix status so the backstop stays current.
Each advisory: id, component (must match a soup.lock.json component name),
ranges [{introduced, fixed}] (fixed is the first SAFE version, exclusive;
omit fixed if unfixed), optional 'versions' (exact affected list), severity,
summary, link. A pinned version is affected if it is >= introduced and,
The seed entries below are real, long-fixed CVEs against the (currently
UNLINKED) zlib, kept as worked examples: they show the matcher running and
confirm the pinned zlib 1.3.1 is past them. cvecheck fails the build only on
a LINKED component with an unpatched match; unlinked matches are reported

advisories.summary: Heap buffer over-read/overflow in inflate() via a large gzip header extra field.
Memory corruption in deflate() when compressing with a large memLevel/certain inputs.
